title: Adrenal crisis — IMMEDIATE hydrocortisone 100 mg IV (do not delay)
recommendation: Hydrocortisone 100 mg IV bolus IMMEDIATELY (do not await cortisol). Aggressive 0.9% saline + dextrose if hypoglycaemic. Treat hyperkalaemia (Ca/insulin-dextrose if > 6.5). Identify precipitant (sepsis/surgery/missed dose/withdrawal of long-term steroid). Hydrocortisone 50 mg IV q6h × 24h then taper. Fludrocortisone 50–200 mcg/d only when on lower hydrocortisone (primary AI). EDUCATION CRITICAL: sick day rule (double dose for fever), emergency injectable hydrocortisone, MedicAlert, surgical stress dosing, NEVER stop chronic steroid abruptly.
rationale: Endocrine Society 2016/2024 + ATA/Pituitary 2020.

title: Pituitary apoplexy — hydrocortisone + urgent MRI + neurosurgical MDT
indicators: sudden headache + visual deficit + reduced consciousness
recommendation: Hydrocortisone 100 mg IV bolus + 50 mg q6h (secondary AI common). IV fluids for hypotension. Glucose for hypoglycaemia. URGENT MRI pituitary. Hormonal panel (cortisol, ACTH, TSH/T4, prolactin, LH/FSH, IGF-1, GH). Formal visual fields. Neurosurgical MDT: trans-sphenoidal decompression if deteriorating vision/ophthalmoplegia/GCS reduction; conservative if stable. Hormone replacement: hydrocortisone before levothyroxine (reverse precipitates crisis); testosterone/estrogen; DDAVP if DI; GH specialist. Lifelong endocrine review.
rationale: Endocrine Society 2017 + Society for Endocrinology UK.

title: Hyperkalaemia — Ca protect + insulin/dex shift + binder/loop/dialysis
recommendation: ECG monitor. 1) Ca gluconate 10% 10 ml IV (stabilise membrane, 1–3 min, lasts 30–60); 2) Insulin 10 U IV + 25 g dextrose (50 ml 50% or 250 ml 10%) over 30 min — monitor glucose q1h × 6h; 3) Salbutamol 10–20 mg neb; 4) Bicarb 50 mmol if acidotic only; 5) Patiromer 8.4 g or SZC 10 g for sustained removal; 6) Furosemide 40 mg IV if hypervolaemic + functioning kidney; 7) DIALYSIS if AKI / refractory / severe acidosis. Stop offending drugs (RAAS / K+ supp / spiro / NSAID / TMP); diet K < 2 g/d; AVOID K-substitute salt. Chronic CKD/HF on RAAS: patiromer/SZC to maintain RAAS rather than stop permanently.
rationale: ERA-EDTA 2022 + UK Renal Assoc 2023 + KDIGO 2024.

title: Hyponatraemia — 3% NaCl 150 ml for severe symptoms; max rise 10/24h
recommendation: Severe symptoms (seizure/coma): 3% NaCl 150 ml IV over 20 min, repeat × 2 if needed; aim Na rise 5 mmol/L in 1h to resolve neuro; then SLOW — max rise 8–10 mmol/L in first 24h (avoid osmotic demyelination). Volume status assessment: hypovolaemic → 0.9% NaCl; euvolaemic SIADH → fluid restrict 800–1000 ml/d + salt + urea / tolvaptan refractory; hypervolaemic → fluid + salt restrict + loop diuretic. Treat cause (drugs, malignancy, hypothyroid, adrenal). Pseudo (lipid/protein) + hypertonic (hyperglycaemia) — no treatment. Overcorrection > 10 mmol/L/24h: D5W + DDAVP to re-lower.
rationale: ESE 2014 + AHA/ASN + Sterns NEJM 2015.

title: Diabetic foot — IWGDF 5 pillars + offloading TCC + MDT
recommendation: Classify (Wagner/IWGDF). Vascular: ABI/toe pressure/CTA, revasc if CLI. Neuro: 10 g monofilament. Probe-to-bone + X-ray ± MRI for OM. Tissue/bone culture (NOT superficial). 5 PILLARS: control INFECTION (oral mild flucloxacillin/cephalexin 7–14 d; IV broad-spectrum severe — pip-tazo / meropenem ± vanc; OM 6 wk antibiotic + debride), control ISCHAEMIA (revasc), control PRESSURE (TCC gold standard plantar; removable cast walker), WOUND care (sharp debride + moist + honey LMIC; NPWT selected; avoid H2O2/iodine routine), GLUCOSE/risk factor. CHARCOT: hot swollen foot + neuropathy = high index of suspicion; immediate TCC + non-weight-bearing 8–12 wk; reconstruct selected. Multidisciplinary foot clinic reduces amputation. Annual screen + education.
rationale: IWGDF 2023 + IDSA 2024 + NICE NG19.

title: COPD GOLD 2024 — ABE category-based; ICS only if eos ≥ 300
recommendation: Smoking cessation + pulm rehab + vaccinations (flu/pneumo/RSV/COVID). GOLD ABE: A = SABA/SAMA; B = LABA+LAMA; E (exacerbator) = LABA+LAMA, ADD ICS if eos ≥ 300 (triple — IMPACT/ETHOS); roflumilast for FEV1 < 50% + chronic bronchitis + frequent exac; macrolide 3×/wk selected. LTOT for PaO2 ≤ 7.3 ≥ 15 h/d; target sats 88–92%. Alpha-1AT screen if young/non-smoker/lower-lobe. Exacerbation: SABA+SAMA neb, prednisolone 30 mg × 5 d (REDUCE), antibiotic if 2/3 Anthonisen × 5 d, controlled O2 88–92%, NIV for pH < 7.35 + pCO2 > 6. Lung volume reduction / transplant / palliative for advanced.
rationale: GOLD 2024 + ERS/ATS 2023 + REDUCE/IMPACT/ETHOS.

title: Asthma GINA 2024 — ICS-formoterol reliever + controller (no SABA only)
recommendation: Step 1–2: as-needed low-dose ICS-formoterol (preferred) or daily low-dose ICS + SABA. Step 3: low-dose ICS-LABA daily + ICS-formoterol prn. Step 4: medium-dose ICS-LABA + prn. Step 5: high-dose ICS-LABA + LAMA (triple) + assess biologics. NEVER SABA-only (SABINA — mortality). Severe asthma biologics: omalizumab IgE / mepolizumab/benralizumab eos / dupilumab T2 / tezepelumab TSLP (NAVIGATOR). Exacerbation: salbutamol q20 min + pred 50 mg × 5 d; severe — neb + ipratropium + IV MgSO4 2 g + IV steroid + sats 93–95%; refractory — IV salbutamol/ketamine/ICU. Inhaler technique + spacer + action plan + adherence annually.
rationale: GINA 2024 + BTS/SIGN + ERS/ATS Severe + SABINA + NAVIGATOR.

title: CAP — CURB-65 + amoxicillin + macrolide; 5-day non-severe
recommendation: CURB-65: 0–1 outpatient amoxicillin 1g TDS × 5 d (PRECISE); 2 admit amox + clarithro 5–7 d; 3–5/severe IV co-amox + macrolide or ceftriaxone + azithro × 7 d; ICU if ≥ 4. Always SSA: AFB sputum/GeneXpert for TB; HIV test; PCP cover if HIV+ pO2 < 9.3 (cotrim 1920 TID + steroid). Treat atypicals (Mycoplasma/Legionella/Chlamydia) — macrolide / doxy / FQ. Empyema: drain + 4–6 wk antibiotic; tPA+DNase (MIST2) for locu-lated. O2 target 94–98% (88–92% COPD). Switch IV→PO when stable. CXR follow-up at 6 wk if > 50 / smoker (rule out malignancy). Pneumococcal + flu + RSV vaccine.
rationale: BTS 2024 + ATS/IDSA 2019 + ERS/ESCMID 2023 + PRECISE 2024.

title: HAP/VAP — local antibiogram-guided + de-escalate at 48–72h
recommendation: Risk-stratify MDR. Low risk: ceftriaxone or co-amoxiclav. High risk MDR: anti-pseudomonal β-lactam (pip-tazo / cefepime / meropenem) + second anti-pseudo if septic (cipro / aminoglycoside) + vanc/linezolid if MRSA risk. Duration 7 days (most — non-inferior); 14 d Staph/Pseudo/non-responsive/immunocompromised. De-escalate per culture + procalcitonin. VAP prevention bundle: HOB 30–45°, daily SAT+SBT, oral care, subglottic ETT, cuff pressure 20–30, hand hygiene + chlorhex bathing, early enteral. Failure 48–72h: review C+S, repeat imaging, consider TB/fungal/viral/PCP.
rationale: IDSA/ATS 2016 + ERS/ESICM 2017 + WHO AWaRe.

title: ARDS — lung-protective Vt 4–6 ml/kg PBW + prone for P/F < 150
recommendation: Berlin criteria. Lung-protective: Vt 4–6 ml/kg PBW, plateau ≤ 30, driving pressure < 15, PEEP per ARDSNet table (higher for moderate-severe), permissive hypercapnia pH ≥ 7.15, sats 88–95%. P/F < 150: PRONE ≥ 16h/d (PROSEVA). Severe + refractory: cisatracurium × 48h, NMBA. Conservative fluid (FACTT). Dexamethasone 20 mg × 5 d then 10 mg × 5 d (DEXA-ARDS). ECMO if P/F < 80 refractory (EOLIA). Light sedation + SAT/SBT + ABCDEF + early mobilise. Treat trigger. Post-ICU rehab + mental health screen.
rationale: ATS/ESICM/SCCM 2017/2024 + ARDSNet + PROSEVA + DEXA-ARDS + EOLIA.

title: OSA — STOP-Bang + PSG + CPAP first-line + weight loss / tirzepatide
recommendation: STOP-Bang + ESS screen; PSG (or HSAT if high pretest + no comorbidity). AHI staging. Lifestyle: weight loss (10% → AHI -26%), avoid ETOH evening, lateral position, treat nasal obstruction. CPAP first-line moderate-severe + symptomatic mild (target ≥ 4h × 70% nights). MAD for mild-mod or CPAP-intolerant. ADENOTONSILLECTOMY first-line paediatric. Tirzepatide for OSA+obesity (SURMOUNT-OSA). Solriamfetol/pitolisant for residual EDS. AVOID hypnotic/opioid. ASV CONTRAINDICATED in HFrEF (SERVE-HF). Bariatric surgery improves/resolves. Treat HTN/AF — OSA worsens both.
rationale: AASM 2019 + ERS/ESC 2024 + SURMOUNT-OSA + SERVE-HF.

title: IPF — pirfenidone/nintedanib antifibrotic + transplant referral early
indicators: UIP pattern on HRCT + restrictive PFT
recommendation: MDT-confirmed UIP. ANTIFIBROTIC: pirfenidone 267→801 mg TID (sun protect, LFT) or nintedanib 150 BD (diarrhoea, LFT, anticoag caution). Both slow FVC decline. Pulm rehab. O2 for sats < 88%. Treat GERD (PPI). Cough — opiate, gabapentin. Vaccinate flu/pneumo/COVID. Refer LUNG TRANSPLANT EARLY: DLCO < 40, FVC < 80, ≥ 5% FVC decline 6 mo, O2-dependent. Acute exacerbation: rule out infection/PE/cardiac, high-dose methylpred 500–1000 mg × 3 d (modest), palliation 50-80% mortality. PALLIATIVE CARE early. Other PF-ILD (HP, NSIP) — nintedanib per INBUILD.
rationale: ATS/ERS/JRS/ALAT 2022 + ASCEND/CAPACITY + INPULSIS + INBUILD.

title: Status epilepticus — benzo→2nd-line→anaesthesia stepped algorithm
recommendation: 0–5 min: ABC + lateral + suction + O2 + IV + glucose ± thiamine. 5–20 min: lorazepam 0.1 mg/kg IV (max 4 mg) or midazolam 10 mg IM (RAMPART) or buccal/IN — repeat × 1. 20–40 min: levetiracetam 60 mg/kg IV (max 4500) OR phenytoin 20 mg/kg IV (max 1500, ≤ 50 mg/min — fosphenytoin safer) OR valproate 40 mg/kg (avoid pregnancy/liver/mito) — ESETT all equivalent ~50%. > 60 min: anaesthesia + intubate + cEEG — midazolam 0.05-2 mg/kg/h, propofol (PIS > 24h), pentobarb burst suppression, ketamine. Specific: hypogly D50, hypoNa 3% saline, eclampsia MgSO4, INH pyridoxine 5 g, encephalitis aciclovir+steroid, alcohol withdrawal BZD (not phenytoin). Long-term AED + cause + driving advice + rescue benzo.
rationale: AES 2016/2024 + ILAE 2015 + NICE NG217 + ESETT + RAMPART.

title: Paediatric sepsis — recognise age-specific + FEAST cautious bolus
indicators: child with infection signs + tachycardia / mottling / altered mental state
recommendation: Phoenix Sepsis Score 2024. Recognise age-specific vital signs. WITHIN 1H: blood culture + ceftriaxone 50–80 mg/kg (add vanc if MRSA risk, anti-pseudo if neutropenic). FLUID: 10–20 ml/kg balanced crystalloid bolus over 5–10 min — reassess; FEAST trial — AVOID bolus in non-shock African children (harmful); maintenance only if compensated. VASOPRESSOR adrenaline 0.05–0.3 mcg/kg/min (paeds first-line, vs adult NA). Hydrocortisone 50 mg/m² × 4 if fluid-refractory. Source control 6–12h. Malaria endemic: artesunate 2.4 mg/kg if RDT+ (AQUAMAT). Meningococcal: ceftriaxone + PEP cipro for contacts. Neonatal: ampicillin + gent / cefotaxime early, vanc + cefepime late + acyclovir for HSV; LP all. Prevention: vaccines, breastfeeding, ITN.
rationale: Surviving Sepsis Paediatric 2020 + Phoenix 2024 + FEAST + AQUAMAT.

title: PH — WHO group + RHC + group-specific therapy; CTEPH curable
recommendation: Echo screening → RHC for definitive (mPAP > 20). V/Q scan to rule out CTEPH. Workup: HIV / schisto / CTD / portal / sleep / lung / left heart. GROUP 1 PAH: dual oral ERA + PDE5i (AMBITION); add prostacyclin for high risk (epoprostenol IV, treprostinil); sotatercept (STELLAR 2023); selexipag; transplant for refractory. GROUP 2 (LHD): treat LHD; AVOID PAH therapy. GROUP 3 (lung/hypoxia): optimise + O2 + inhaled treprostinil if ILD (INCREASE). GROUP 4 CTEPH: lifelong anticoag + PEA (surgical CURE) > BPA / riociguat. Avoid pregnancy. Flu+pneumo vaccines. Schisto-PAH (common SSA): praziquantel + PAH therapy.
rationale: ESC/ERS PH 2022 + AMBITION + STELLAR + INCREASE.

title: UC — 5-ASA topical + oral; biologic / JAK / S1P for moderate-severe
recommendation: Proctitis: 5-ASA suppositories; left-sided: enemas + oral 5-ASA 2.4–4.8 g; extensive moderate-severe: oral 5-ASA + budesonide MMX / prednisolone + AZA. Moderate-severe failed conventional: anti-TNF (infliximab), vedolizumab, ustekinumab, risankizumab/mirikizumab, tofacitinib/upadacitinib (JAK BBW), ozanimod/etrasimod (S1P). ACUTE SEVERE UC: admit IV hydrocort 100 q6h × 3 d + VTE prophylaxis; rule out infection + CMV; day 3 reassess — failed → infliximab/ciclosporin rescue OR COLECTOMY at day 5–7 if failed rescue. Treat-to-target STRIDE-II. TB/HBV/varicella screen before biologic. Surveillance colonoscopy from 8–10 y. PSC-UC: ursodeoxycholic acid + MRCP.
rationale: ECCO 2022 + AGA 2024 + BSG 2024 + ELEVATE/TRUE NORTH.

title: Crohn's — biologic early (top-down) for severe/fistulising + STRIDE-II
recommendation: Treat-to-target. Mild: budesonide 9 mg (ileocaecal). Moderate-severe: corticosteroid + immunomodulator (AZA / MTX) ± biologic. Severe / fistulising / steroid-dependent: biologic EARLY (anti-TNF infliximab best fistula, adalimumab, certolizumab; combo with AZA per SONIC). Vedolizumab, ustekinumab, risankizumab, upadacitinib (BBW — avoid elderly/CV/VTE). Perianal: MRI + EUA + setons + abscess drainage + anti-TNF + cipro/metro adjunct. Stricture: dilatation/strictureplasty; biologic for inflammatory. Drain abscess before immunosuppression. Surgery NOT curative; biologic prophylaxis post-op high-risk (POCER). B12 + iron + vit D supplementation. SMOKING CESSATION critical. Vaccinate before biologic; TB/HBV screen.
rationale: ECCO 2022/2024 + AGA 2024 + STRIDE-II + SONIC + U-EXCEL.

title: Chronic HBV — tenofovir lifelong; WHO simplified eligibility 2024
recommendation: WHO 2024 simplified: TREAT if any of — cirrhosis, fibrosis ≥ F2, persistent ALT raised + DNA > 2000, HBeAg+ significant disease, pregnant DNA > 200k (PMTCT). FIRST-LINE: tenofovir TDF 300 mg or TAF 25 mg daily (lifelong most); entecavir alternative. AVOID lamivudine mono / interferon SSA. Monitor ALT + DNA 3-monthly then 6-monthly; HCC surveillance US ± AFP 6-monthly cirrhotic + Asian/African criteria. Pregnancy DNA > 200k: tenofovir from 28 wk to 4 wk PP + infant HBIG + vaccine within 12h. HIV-HBV: ART with 2 anti-HBV (TDF+3TC); never stop. HDV: bulevirtide. UNIVERSAL infant vaccination + healthcare worker + high-risk catch-up. Address NHIF / generic TDF access in SSA.
rationale: WHO 2024 + EASL 2024 + AASLD 2018+ + Kenya National Viral Hepatitis Plan.

title: HCV — pan-genotypic DAA 8–12 weeks (cure ≥ 95%)
recommendation: Pan-genotypic regimens (WHO simplified — no genotype needed): glecaprevir/pibrentasvir 8 wk (no cirrhosis) / 12 wk (compensated cirrhosis) OR sofosbuvir/velpatasvir 12 wk (+ ribavirin if decompensated/NS5A failure). Check drug interactions (amiodarone, statins, anticonvulsants, rifampicin). DECOMPENSATED: avoid protease inhibitor regimens; sof/vel + ribavirin × 12 wk; refer transplant. HBV reactivation risk — check HBsAg pre-DAA, treat with TDF if positive concurrently. HIV-HCV: same DAA, check ART interactions. Verify SVR12 at 12 wk post-treatment. Cirrhotic — continue HCC surveillance. Re-infection counsel PWID/MSM. WHO 2030 elimination target; advocate generic access.

title: MASLD/MASH — FIB-4 stratify; weight loss + resmetirom F2-F3
recommendation: Stratify with FIB-4 then FibroScan/ELF if intermediate-high. Refer hepatology if F2+. Lifestyle: Mediterranean diet + 7–10% weight loss (reverses MASH) + exercise. Medical: RESMETIROM 80 mg/d for MASH F2-F3 (MAESTRO-NASH 2024 — FIRST approved); semaglutide / tirzepatide for weight + DM + MASH; vitamin E 800 IU non-diabetic biopsy NASH; pioglitazone in T2DM. Bariatric for BMI ≥ 35 + metabolic syndrome. Treat comorbidities aggressively (CV main cause of death): ACE/ARB for HTN, SGLT2i + GLP-1RA for DM, STATINS SAFE (improve outcomes), CPAP for OSA. Avoid alcohol, hepatotoxins. Coffee 2-3 cups protective. HCC surveillance if cirrhotic.
rationale: AASLD 2023 + EASL/EASD/EASO 2024 + MAESTRO-NASH + Multi-Society nomenclature.

title: Acute pancreatitis — moderate fluid (WATERFALL) + early feeding + ERCP if cholangitis
recommendation: Diagnose with 2 of 3 (pain/lipase 3xULN/imaging). Severity: Atlanta 2012 (mild/moderately severe/severe) + BISAP + SIRS; CT delayed to 72–96h. MODERATE Ringer's lactate goal-directed UO > 0.5 ml/kg/h (NOT aggressive — WATERFALL 2022). Pain control opioid. Early enteral feeding within 24–72h (NJ if not tolerating PO) — NOT NPO. NO prophylactic antibiotics (PROPATRIA harm). Gallstone + cholangitis/persistent obstruction: ERCP + sphincterotomy in 24–48h. SAME-admission cholecystectomy for mild gallstone (PONCHO). Alcohol cessation + thiamine. Hypertriglyceridaemia > 1000: insulin/heparin/plasmapheresis. Severe/necrotising: HDU/ICU, NJ feeds; infected necrosis (clinical deterioration > 1 wk + gas/positive FNA) = meropenem + STEP-UP drainage (PANTER — percutaneous first, then endoscopic, then surgical; AVOID early open surgery; delay > 4 wk).
rationale: ACG 2024 + Atlanta 2012/2024 + WATERFALL + PANTER + PONCHO.

title: UGIB — restrictive Hb 70 + endoscopy 24h + variceal terlipressin/ceftriaxone
recommendation: GBS pre-endoscopic. Resus 2× large-bore + restrictive transfusion target Hb 70 (Villanueva) — NOT routine TXA (HALT-IT no benefit). Reverse anticoag: idarucizumab (dabigatran) / andexanet (Xa inhibitors) / 4F-PCC+vit K (warfarin). Variceal suspicion (cirrhosis): terlipressin 2 mg IV q4h or octreotide 50 mcg + 50 mcg/h + ceftriaxone 1 g/d × 7 d. Endoscopy within 24h. Forrest Ia/b/IIa: dual modality endoscopic therapy + IV PPI 80 mg bolus + 8 mg/h × 72h. Varices: band ligation ± glue; TIPSS for refractory / early in high-risk. H. pylori test + eradicate ulcer. Restart anticoag within 7 d if low rebleed + high thrombotic. NSAID stop or PPI cover + COX-2. Repeat endo at 6–8 wk for gastric ulcer (cancer exclusion). Variceal secondary prevention NSBB + EVL.
rationale: BSG 2024 + NICE CG141 + Villanueva NEJM 2013 + HALT-IT 2020.

title: H. pylori — bismuth quadruple 14 d first-line in high resistance regions
recommendation: Test (UBT or stool antigen — off PPI 2 wk, antibiotic 4 wk); serology limited. Indications: ulcer (current/past), uninvestigated dyspepsia < 55 no alarms, MALT, post-gastric Ca, IDA, ITP, NSAID/aspirin chronic + risk, family Ca. HIGH RESISTANCE (Africa, S Asia, S Europe — most): BISMUTH QUADRUPLE 14 d (bismuth + tetracycline + metronidazole + PPI). Low clarithro resistance (< 15%): clarithro triple 14 d. CONCOMITANT (PPI+amox+clarithro+metro) alternative. Vonoprazan-based emerging. Verify eradication 4 wk post-treatment (UBT/stool — off PPI 2 wk). Second-line: bismuth quadruple if not used or levofloxacin triple. Third-line: refer endoscopy + culture-guided. Continue PPI 4-8 wk ulcer; repeat endo at 6-8 wk gastric ulcer (cancer).
rationale: Maastricht VI/Florence 2022 + ACG 2024 + Houston 2018.

title: Cirrhosis — Baveno VII; carvedilol primary varix prophylaxis + SBP albumin
recommendation: Aetiology directed: alcohol cessation + naltrexone/baclofen; HBV TDF lifelong; HCV DAA cure; MASH resmetirom F2-F3 + tirzepatide; AIH steroid+AZA. Variceal primary prophylaxis: CARVEDILOL 12.5 mg/d (superior — Garcia-Tsao 2024) or NSBB or EVL for medium/large. HCC surveillance US ± AFP 6-monthly. Ascites: Na restrict + spironolactone+furosemide 100:40; SBP — diagnostic tap (> 250 PMN) → ceftriaxone 5–7 d + albumin 1.5 g/kg d1 + 1 g/kg d3 (HRS prevent) + norfloxacin secondary prophylaxis. HE: lactulose ± rifaximin 550 BD; treat precipitant. Variceal bleed: terlipressin/octreotide + ceftriaxone + EVL ± TIPSS early. HRS: albumin + terlipressin; refer transplant urgently. Transplant referral MELD ≥ 15 / decompensation / HCC Milan. HCC: resection / RFA / TACE / atezo+bev (IMbrave-150). Vaccinate. Avoid NSAIDs / paracetamol max 2 g / BZD / aminoglycoside. Dietetics — 1.2–1.5 g/kg protein.
rationale: EASL 2018/2024 + AASLD 2021 + Baveno VII 2022 + IMbrave-150.

title: IBS — Rome IV + low FODMAP + CBT/hypno + targeted pharm
indicators: chronic abdominal pain + altered bowel habit, Rome IV criteria
recommendation: Limited workup: FBC + CRP + calprotectin (< 50 rules out IBD) + coeliac + TSH. NO routine colonoscopy < 50 no alarms. Education biopsychosocial. Dietary: regular meals + reduce trigger; LOW FODMAP 6–8 wk elimination + structured reintroduction with dietitian (NICE 2nd line); soluble fibre (psyllium) for IBS-C; AVOID insoluble fibre (bran). CBT (Mahana 2021) + gut-directed hypnotherapy strong evidence. Pharm: IBS-C — PEG / linaclotide / plecanatide / prucalopride; IBS-D — loperamide / rifaximin 550 TID × 14 d (TARGET) / bile acid binders (BAD subset); antispasmodic mebeverine / peppermint oil; TCA low-dose amitriptyline 10–25 mg nocte (ATLANTIS 2023). Refractory: refer gastro / psychology.
rationale: BSG 2021 + ACG 2021 + Rome IV 2024 + Mahana + ATLANTIS.

title: MDD — stepped care + suicide risk + medication 4–6 wk trial
recommendation: Rule out bipolar (MDQ/HCL-32) before antidepressant. Rule out TSH/B12/anaemia. Active suicide = urgent assessment. Mild-mod: low-intensity CBT / behavioural activation / exercise; mhGAP PM+ for LMIC; Friendship Bench lay-counsellor. Mod-severe: SSRI (sertraline 50 mg preferred; allow 4–6 wk therapeutic dose; continue 6–12 mo post-remission); + CBT/IPT. Severe/TRD: psychiatry — switch antidepressant, lithium augment, atypical antipsychotic, ECT, esketamine, rTMS. Pregnancy/breastfeeding: sertraline preferred. Paediatric: fluoxetine first-line. Elderly: low + slow, avoid TCA. NEVER antidepressant alone for bipolar depression. Address physical health (CV mortality risk doubled). Means restriction + safety planning + lithium for chronic suicidality in MDD.
rationale: NICE NG222 + WHO mhGAP IG-2 + BAP + STAR*D + Friendship Bench.

title: Bipolar — mood stabiliser + antipsychotic; AVOID antidepressant monotherapy
recommendation: STOP antidepressant if currently on. Acute mania: lithium (0.6-1.0 mmol/L) + atypical antipsychotic (olanzapine/risperidone/quetiapine); short BZD for agitation; ECT for severe/preg. Bipolar DEPRESSION: NEVER antidepressant alone — quetiapine 300 mg, lurasidone, olanzapine+fluoxetine, lithium, lamotrigine (slow titrate SJS), cariprazine. Maintenance: lithium first-line (suicide-protective; monitor renal/thyroid/Ca q6mo); valproate NOT WCBP (NPPP); quetiapine/lurasidone; lamotrigine for depression-predominant. IPSRT + family-focused therapy + psychoed. Pregnancy: avoid valproate; lithium safe (withdraw 24h pre-delivery, restart immediately post); lamotrigine safer + monitor levels (clearance changes); postpartum prophylaxis CRITICAL. Lithium toxicity (Li > 1.2): hold + hydrate; dialysis if > 2.5. Annual metabolic monitoring.
rationale: NICE CG185 + CANMAT/ISBD 2024 + BAP + mhGAP.

title: Schizophrenia / FEP — atypical antipsychotic + EIP team + clozapine TRS
recommendation: First-episode: refer EIP within 2 weeks (OPUS — best outcomes). Atypical antipsychotic LOW + SLOW: risperidone 0.5–6 mg / aripiprazole / olanzapine (metabolic); avoid haloperidol high-dose first-line. Switch if no response in 4–6 wk at therapeutic dose; trial 2-3 before TRS. TRS (failed 2+): CLOZAPINE — only evidence-based — mandatory FBC + cardiac/troponin monitoring; agranulocytosis 1% / myocarditis weeks 1-3 / ileus BBW / metabolic. Always combine CBTp + family + vocational + LAI for adherence (Tiihonen — LAI reduces relapse + mortality). Acute agitation: oral preferred (olanzapine 10 / risperidone 2 / lorazepam); IM olanzapine NOT with IV benzo (resp arrest). Annual metabolic + physical (huge mortality gap — CV main cause). Smoking cessation. Pregnancy: olanzapine/quetiapine/aripiprazole preferred. Anti-NMDA encephalitis screen if atypical/young woman.
rationale: NICE CG178 + Maudsley 2024 + BAP + OPUS + mhGAP.

title: AUD — detox + thiamine + MAT (naltrexone / acamprosate / disulfiram)
recommendation: Brief intervention + motivational interviewing for hazardous drinking. DETOX: CIWA-Ar–guided chlordiazepoxide 20–40 q6h taper 5–7 d (or diazepam; lorazepam in hepatic). IV THIAMINE 100 mg × 3 d (high-dose Pabrinex if malnourished/severe withdrawal) — BEFORE glucose (precipitates Wernicke). Folate + multivit + Mg/PO4 (refeeding). DT: HDU + IV diazepam titrated; refractory — phenobarb/propofol/dexmed. Wernicke: thiamine 500 mg TDS IV × 2-3 d. Maintenance MAT: naltrexone 50 mg PO or 380 mg/mo IM; acamprosate 2 g/d (renal); disulfiram supervised; baclofen safer in cirrhosis. + Psychosocial (AA, CBT, MI, contingency). Alcoholic hepatitis severe (Maddrey > 32): prednisolone 40 × 28 d + Lille day 7. WHO SAFER population strategies. Kenya: NACADA + Alcoholic Drinks Control Act. Pregnancy: no safe amount — counsel WCBP.
rationale: WHO SAFER + NICE CG115 + APA 2018 + COMBINE + NACADA.

title: OUD — buprenorphine or methadone MAT + take-home naloxone + HIV/HCV link
recommendation: MAT lifesaving — first-line. METHADONE 30 mg start → 60-120 mg target; DOT; QTc monitor (> 100 mg); drug interactions CYP3A4. BUPRENORPHINE/naloxone (Suboxone): wait COWS ≥ 12 then 2-4 mg → 8 mg day 1; titrate 8-24 mg; safer overdose profile (ceiling); office-based; microinduction (Bernese) if fentanyl user (avoid precip withdrawal); long-acting injectable (Sublocade/Brixadi). XR NALTREXONE 380 mg IM/mo for motivated post-detox (7–10 d opioid-free first). Take-home NALOXONE + bystander training all OUD + family. HIV / HCV / HBV testing + linkage to care; HCV treat regardless of active use (REACH HCV); PrEP if HIV-. SSPs (needle exchange). Pregnancy: methadone or buprenorphine (both first-line); avoid abrupt withdrawal; NOWS supportive + morphine taper severe. Post-incarceration: continue MAT + naloxone on release (overdose mortality peak first 2 weeks). Address stigma — chronic relapsing disease. Kenya MAT programmes (Mombasa, Nairobi) + NACADA.
rationale: WHO 2024 + SAMHSA TIP 63 + MOTHER + REACH HCV.

title: PTSD — TF-CBT / EMDR / NET first-line; SSRI second-line
recommendation: PSYCHOLOGICAL first-line: TF-CBT, CPT, PE, EMDR, NET; WHO Self-Help+ / PM+ for LMIC + refugees (Kakuma / Dadaab Kenya). Pharm second-line / adjunct: sertraline 50-200 mg or paroxetine 20-60 mg (FDA-approved); venlafaxine; mirtazapine for sleep; prazosin 1-10 mg nocte for nightmares. EMERGING: MDMA-assisted psychotherapy (Phase 3); ketamine; psilocybin. AVOID: benzodiazepines (worsen + dependence), single-session debriefing post-trauma (no benefit/may worsen), polypharmacy. Acute Stress Disorder: watchful waiting; early TF-CBT for moderate-severe. Complex PTSD: STAIR+NST, mentalisation, DBT skills. Substance use + comorbid mental illness — integrate. Refugees/conflict-affected: mhGAP + lay-counsellor (Friendship Bench-style). Paediatric: TF-CBT + caregiver involvement; avoid pharm first-line.
rationale: WHO Stress Guidelines + NICE NG116 + ISTSS 2024 + Bryant.

title: Anxiety — stepped care + CBT + SSRI; AVOID benzo maintenance
recommendation: Rule out medical: TSH, ECG, caffeine/substances/withdrawal. Stepped care (NICE): Step 1 education. Step 2 guided self-help + digital CBT. Step 3 high-intensity CBT or medication — SSRI first-line (sertraline / escitalopram / citalopram); SNRI (venlafaxine / duloxetine); pregabalin for GAD; buspirone mild; propranolol PRN performance anxiety. Allow 8–12 wk; continue 6–12 mo post-response. Step 4 specialist combination + augmentation. AVOID benzo long-term (dependence, falls, RTAs); short < 4 wk acute crisis only; taper 10-25%/1-2 wk if dependent. Panic: CBT (interoceptive exposure) + SSRI; AVOID benzo maintenance. SAD: CBT + SSRI; propranolol PRN performance. OCD: CBT-ERP + SSRI higher doses. Pregnancy: sertraline + CBT. Paeds: CBT first; fluoxetine / sertraline. Elderly: SSRI low + slow, avoid benzo. Lifestyle: exercise, reduce caffeine/ETOH, sleep.
rationale: NICE CG113 + WFSBP + WHO mhGAP + BAP.

title: Eating disorders — FBT adolescent AN + CBT-ED + watch refeeding syndrome
recommendation: MDT (specialist ED + dietitian + psych + GP). AN: adolescent — FAMILY-BASED TREATMENT (Maudsley) first-line; adult — CBT-ED / MANTRA / SSCM. Nutritional rehab START LOW 1200–1400 kcal/d, increase gradually — WATCH REFEEDING SYNDROME daily PO4 + K + Mg + glucose; replace BEFORE feeding if low; thiamine 200 mg/d. ECG / orthostatic / bradycardia monitor. Admit if BMI < 13 / rapid loss / electrolytes / CV unstable / suicide. Olanzapine low-dose may help weight + anxiety; SSRI for comorbid AFTER weight restored. Bone — DEXA + Ca + vit D. BN: CBT-ED first-line + fluoxetine 60 mg/d (only FDA approved); address electrolytes (hypoK from vomiting). BED: CBT-ED + lisdexamfetamine (FDA) / SSRI / topiramate. ARFID: MDT including OT + sensory. Pregnancy: relapse risk; specialist multi-D. Comorbidity (depression / anxiety / OCD / SUD / BPD) — integrate. Long-term follow-up — relapse common.
rationale: NICE NG69 + APA 2023 + AED + Maudsley FBT.

title: ADHD — behavioural + stimulant 1st-line; non-stimulant for comorbidity
recommendation: Comprehensive assessment + multiple informants + rule out hearing/vision/sleep/anxiety/depression/learning/autism/medical (TSH/lead) + CV screen (FHx sudden death/structural). Children: parent training + school accommodation first-line for preschool; medication added age 6+. Stimulants 1st-line: methylphenidate / lisdexamfetamine / amphetamine — long-acting preferred for adherence + abuse-deterrent; titrate slowly; monitor BP/HR/weight/height/mood/appetite/sleep. Non-stimulant 2nd-line / comorbid tic / anxiety / SUD: atomoxetine (suicidal ideation BBW), guanfacine/clonidine, viloxazine. Adult: CBT for adult ADHD + medication usually combined. Pregnancy: limited data, risk-benefit. Comorbidity high (50%+) — treat in parallel. Combination stimulant + α2-agonist for partial response. Transition child→adult care critical (high dropout 18+). Driving counsel — improvement with treatment. Public health: school training + accommodation + anti-stigma.
rationale: NICE NG87 + AAP 2019 + BAP + CADDRA + WFADHD.

title: Dementia — modifiable RFs + ChEI / memantine + new anti-amyloid early AD + BPSD DICE
recommendation: Rule out reversible: TSH/B12/folate/Ca/glucose/HIV/syphilis/depression/NPH/drugs/OSA. MRI for atrophy + vascular load. ANTI-AMYLOID for early AD with confirmed amyloid: LECANEMAB / DONANEMAB (CLARITY-AD / TRAILBLAZER-ALZ2) — IV biweekly/monthly; ARIA-E/H MRI surveillance; APOE genotype; access barriers SSA. SYMPTOMATIC: ChEI (donepezil 5–10 mg / rivastigmine / galantamine) for mild-mod AD + DLB + PDD; memantine for mod-severe AD (add to ChEI). Address LANCET COMMISSION 14 MODIFIABLE RFs (~ 45% attributable): education, hearing loss (hearing aids), HTN, smoking, obesity, depression, inactivity, DM, alcohol, TBI, air pollution, social isolation, vision loss, high LDL. Mediterranean/MIND diet + exercise. BPSD: DICE non-pharm first; PRN antipsychotic limit (BBW mortality); AVOID antipsychotic in LEWY (severe sensitivity); trazodone/mirtazapine for sleep/agitation. Advance care planning EARLY while capacity. Driving + safety + financial protection. Caregiver education + respite + screen burnout.
rationale: NICE NG97 + Lancet Commission 2024 + WHO Global Plan + CLARITY-AD + TRAILBLAZER-ALZ2 + FINGER.

title: Migraine — multimodal acute + CGRP era preventive
recommendation: Red flag screen (SNOOP10). Acute: stepped — paracetamol + NSAID + antiemetic; then triptan (sumatriptan 50-100 PO or 6 SC); gepants (ubrogepant/rimegepant/zavegepant) or lasmiditan if triptan contraindicated. Limit triptan/analgesic to 10/15 days/mo. Status migrainosus IV metoclopramide / chlorpromazine + Mg + dexamethasone + GON block. AVOID opioids/barbiturates. PREVENTIVE if ≥ 4 days/mo / disabling: oral first (β-blocker/amitriptyline/topiramate/candesartan); CGRP mAbs (erenumab/fremanezumab/galcanezumab/eptinezumab) or atogepant/rimegepant for chronic / failed orals; Botox for chronic migraine PREEMPT protocol. CGRP also approved cluster (galcanezumab). MOH: withdraw + start preventive + bridge steroid. Pregnancy: paracetamol + metoclopramide; AVOID topiramate/valproate/CGRP; propranolol/amitriptyline ok. Migraine + aura: AVOID combined OCP (stroke risk).
rationale: AHS 2024 + BASH + EHF + NICE CG150 + ICHD-3 + STRIVE/HALO/EVOLVE.

title: MS — early high-efficacy DMT + acute relapse pulse steroid
recommendation: Rule out NMOSD (AQP4) / MOGAD (MOG) — different treatment. Acute relapse: methylpred 1 g IV × 3-5 d (or PO equivalent); PLEX for refractory. EARLY HIGH-EFFICACY DMT preferred (recent comparative trials): ocrelizumab / ofatumumab (anti-CD20), natalizumab (PML risk if JCV+), cladribine, alemtuzumab, S1P modulators (fingolimod/siponimod/ozanimod/ponesimod). PPMS: ocrelizumab (only). SPMS: siponimod (EXPAND). Pre-DMT: vaccinations (live before start), JCV, TB, HBV/HCV, HIV, varicella. Symptomatic: spasticity (baclofen/tizanidine/Sativex/botox), bladder (anticholinergic/mirabegron/botox), fatigue (modafinil/amantadine/exercise), neuropathic pain (gabapentin/pregabalin). Vitamin D + smoking cessation + diet. Pregnancy: IFN/glatiramer compatible; natalizumab cautious extended interval; ocrelizumab washout 6 mo (emerging safe). Postpartum surge — restart DMT.
rationale: ECTRIMS-EAN 2024 + AAN + ORATORIO + EXPAND.

title: Epilepsy — AED by seizure type + AVOID valproate WCBP + refer surgery DRE
recommendation: Diagnose: ≥ 2 unprovoked OR 1 + high recurrence (EEG/MRI). FOCAL: lamotrigine / levetiracetam / oxcarbazepine / lacosamide first-line. GENERALISED TC: valproate (NOT WCBP) / lamotrigine / levetiracetam. ABSENCE: ethosuximide first-line; lamotrigine/valproate. MYOCLONIC: valproate / levetiracetam / topiramate (avoid CBZ/PHT/oxcarbazepine — may worsen). LGS/Dravet: clobazam + rufinamide + cannabidiol (Dravet/LGS) + fenfluramine (Dravet). AVOID valproate in WCBP — NPPP / Pregnancy Prevention Programme; PREFER lamotrigine + levetiracetam pregnancy (folic acid 5 mg pre-conception; monitor levels; vit K). Drug-resistant (failed 2 adequate trials): REFER SURGERY (temporal lobectomy gold standard MTS); VNS / RNS; ketogenic diet. SE (separate). SUDEP education + adherence + nocturnal. Bone health + contraception (enzyme inducers reduce OCP). HLA-B*1502 test before CBZ in Han Chinese / SE Asian. SSA: mhGAP epilepsy + KEML AEDs + investigate neurocysticercosis.
rationale: ILAE 2017/2023 + NICE NG217 + AAN 2024 + WHO mhGAP + MONEAD.

title: PD — levodopa when impaired; rivastigmine for PDD; AVOID typical antipsychotic
recommendation: Clinical diagnosis MDS criteria; DaT scan for ET differential. Levodopa/carbidopa GOLD standard when QOL impaired — no benefit waiting; agonists less wearing-off but impulse control disorders + somnolence + oedema; MAO-B inhibitors adjunct. Advanced: smaller more frequent doses + COMT inhibitor (entacapone/opicapone) + MAO-B + amantadine ER for dyskinesia + apomorphine SC + intrajejunal levodopa + DBS (STN/GPi) + FUS. Non-motor: DEPRESSION — SSRI; DEMENTIA — rivastigmine; PSYCHOSIS — reduce anticholinergic/agonist/amantadine, use clozapine/quetiapine/pimavanserin, AVOID typical antipsychotic + risperidone/olanzapine; SLEEP — melatonin RBD; CONSTIPATION — fibre+PEG; OH — fludrocortisone/midodrine; URGENCY — oxybutynin/mirabegron. Rehab LSVT BIG/LOUD + exercise. NEVER abrupt levodopa stop (NMS-like). Continue PD meds through surgery (rotigotine patch / apomorphine for NPO).
rationale: MDS 2015/2024 + NICE NG71 + EAN/MDS 2024 + AAN.

title: Vertigo — HINTS exam + Epley for BPPV; rule out posterior stroke
recommendation: Detailed history + HINTS exam: peripheral if abnormal head impulse + unidirectional nystagmus + no skew. CENTRAL CONCERN — HINTS-positive / vertical or direction-changing nystagmus / accompanying neurology / vascular RFs → urgent MRI for posterior stroke. BPPV: Dix-Hallpike posterior canal (90%) + supine roll horizontal; EPLEY manoeuvre 70-85% first session; Brandt-Daroff home; AVOID prolonged suppressants. VESTIBULAR NEURITIS: prednisolone 60 mg/d taper × 3 wk (modest evidence); early vestibular rehab; symptom-relief antihistamines 24-72h only. MÉNIÈRE'S: low salt + betahistine 16 TDS; intratympanic dex/gent refractory. VESTIBULAR MIGRAINE: treat as migraine. PPPD: vestibular rehab + SSRI + CBT. Elderly dizziness: med review + multifactorial.
rationale: AAO-HNS 2017 + Bárány Society + NICE CKS + AHA/ASA.

title: Stroke 2° prevention — DAPT 21d + statin LDL<1.4 + BP<130/80 + DOAC if AF
recommendation: Non-cardioembolic minor stroke / high-risk TIA: DAPT clopidogrel + aspirin × 21 d (CHANCE/POINT) then monotherapy. CARDIOEMBOLIC AF: DOAC PREFERRED — apixaban / rivaroxaban / dabigatran / edoxaban; warfarin for mechanical valve / mitral stenosis. Timing 1-3-6-12 day by severity. PFO + cryptogenic stroke < 60 with high-risk features: CLOSURE (RESPECT/CLOSE/REDUCE). STATIN high-intensity (atorva 80 / rosuva 20-40) target LDL < 1.4 ± ezetimibe + PCSK9i. BP < 130/80 gradual (avoid permissive acute first 1-2 wk). DM tight A1c + SGLT2i + GLP1RA. Carotid: CEA symptomatic > 70% within 2 wk. Lifestyle: smoking cessation #1, Mediterranean diet, exercise, weight, sleep, OSA. Stroke rehab unit. Driving 1 mo TIA, longer stroke. Haemorrhagic 2°: BP control + avoid anticoag (unless compelling AF) + manage source.
rationale: AHA/ASA 2021 + ESO 2022 + NICE NG128 + CHANCE/POINT + SPARCL + CLOSE/RESPECT.

title: GBS — IVIG / PLEX + ICU + FVC monitoring + NO steroids
recommendation: ICU/HDU early — autonomic + respiratory monitoring; FVC q4-6h; intubate if FVC < 20 ml/kg / MIP < 30 / MEP < 40. Diagnose with CSF (albuminocytologic dissociation > 1 wk), NCS at 1-2 wk. IVIG 0.4 g/kg/d × 5 d (2 g/kg total) OR PLEX 5 sessions alternate days (equivalent efficacy, NOT combined). NO steroids (not effective). Prophylactic LMWH (high VTE). Pressure care, bowel/bladder, nutrition (NG/PEG if dysphagia), neuropathic pain (gabapentin/amitriptyline), eye care if facial weakness. Autonomic: cardiac monitor, cautious BP control, atropine/pacing for severe brady. Early rehab. Mortality 3-7%, 20% residual disability. Second IVIG/PLEX if treatment-relapse. Differentiate CIDP (> 8 wk progression, steroid-responsive — unlike GBS).
rationale: AAN 2012/2024 + EFNS/PNS + Cochrane IVIG/PLEX.

title: MG — pyridostigmine + steroid + thymectomy + complement / FcRn for refractory
recommendation: AChR + MuSK + LRP4 antibodies; chest CT for thymoma (all). Pyridostigmine 30-60 mg q4-6h symptomatic (less effective MuSK). Prednisolone slow titrate (initial worsening); AZA/MMF/MTX/tac steroid-sparing. RITUXIMAB esp MuSK + refractory AChR. ECULIZUMAB/RAVULIZUMAB (anti-C5 — REGAIN/CHAMPION-MG) + EFGARTIGIMOD (FcRn — ADAPT) + zilucoplan + rozanolixizumab for refractory generalised AChR+ MG. THYMECTOMY: all thymoma; non-thymomatous AChR+ generalised 18-65 (MGTX). MYASTHENIC CRISIS: ICU + intubate early + IVIG 2 g/kg or PLEX × 5; identify trigger. AVOID exacerbating drugs (aminoglycoside/FQ/macrolide/β-blocker/Mg/NMBA/statin/lithium/IFN/ICI). PREGNANCY: pyridostigmine + prednisolone safe; AZA/cyclosporine considered; AVOID MMF/MTX/RTX; IVIG/PLEX safe; vaginal preferred; neonatal MG transient. Anaesthesia: continue meds; AVOID sux; small rocuronium + sugammadex; regional preferred. MedicAlert.
rationale: International Consensus 2020/2024 + EFNS/EAN + MGTX + REGAIN + ADAPT.

title: Headache — SNNOOP10 screen + thunderclap CT/LP + GCA steroid immediate
recommendation: Apply SNNOOP10: Systemic (fever/cancer/HIV), Neoplasm, Neurological deficit/papilloedema, Onset sudden (thunderclap < 1 min), Older (> 50 new), Pattern change, Positional, Precipitated exertion, Painkilling overuse, Pregnancy/postpartum. THUNDERCLAP: urgent CT then LP within 12h if negative → SAH workup; CT-angio for CVT/RCVS/dissection/colloid. GCA > 50 + temporal symptoms / visual / ESR-CRP raised: START PREDNISOLONE 60 mg IMMEDIATELY (don't wait for biopsy — vision loss); biopsy within 1 wk. Meningitis: CT then LP + empirical antibiotics + acyclovir. IIH: weight loss + acetazolamide + topiramate; surgical for vision threat. Cluster: high-flow O2 + SC sumatriptan acute; verapamil + galcanezumab preventive. Paroxysmal hemicrania: indomethacin diagnostic. Trigeminal neuralgia: CBZ + microvascular decompression. Refer neurology: persistent, atypical, refractory, hemiplegic / brainstem.
rationale: ICHD-3 + AAN/AHS 2024 + BASH + NICE CG150 + Do et al SNNOOP10.

title: DSPN — treat cause + duloxetine/gabapentin/pregabalin/amitriptyline for pain
indicators: distal symmetric stocking-glove sensory + motor / pain
recommendation: Investigate cause: HbA1c (often pre-DM neuropathy — 75g OGTT if normal), B12/folate/ferritin, TSH, LFT, U&E, FBC + smear, protein electrophoresis + immunofixation, HIV + syphilis, ANA, drug review. NCS + EMG (axonal vs demyelinating). TREAT CAUSE: DM tight control + SGLT2i/GLP1; B12 IM hydroxocobalamin; alcohol cessation + thiamine; stop offending drug (taxanes, vincristine, isoniazid + B6, metronidazole, amiodarone, phenytoin); HIV ART; leprosy MDT; CIDP IVIG + steroid; vasculitis steroid+CYC/RTX; amyloid TTR-stabilising (tafamidis) or knockdown (patisiran/vutrisiran). PAIN: duloxetine / pregabalin / gabapentin / amitriptyline first-line (any); nortriptyline (better tolerated elderly); topical capsaicin 8% or lidocaine 5%; combination 2 different classes for partial response; AVOID long-term opioids. Foot care (DM separate). Autonomic: gastroparesis metoclopramide, OH fludro/midodrine, ED PDE5i. Physio + AFO for foot drop. Multidisciplinary pain clinic chronic.
rationale: AAN 2022/2024 + NICE NG173 + EFNS CIDP + IASP NeuPSIG.

title: FN — pip-tazo within 1h; vanco for shock/SSTI/severe mucositis
recommendation: Sepsis resus + cultures (2 sets + each line lumen). EMPIRICAL ANTIBIOTIC WITHIN 1H: pip-tazo 4.5 g q8h IV (or cefepime / meropenem if pen-allergy / severe / hospital). ADD vancomycin if shock / pneumonia / SSTI / line infection / severe mucositis / MRSA risk. Aminoglycoside for septic shock. Empirical antifungal (caspofungin / micafungin) if fever > 72h on broad-spectrum + high-risk. MASCC ≥ 21 + low-risk features: outpatient PO cipro + amox-clav. Source control 6-12h. G-CSF for severe/prolonged. Continue 5-7 d minimum + afebrile + recovering. Tunnel line removal if Pseudomonas/fungaemia/persistent/shock. Cotrim PCP prophylaxis for prolonged steroid/ALL/HSCT. Education: thermometer + emergency contact card.
rationale: IDSA + NICE CG151 + ESMO + EORTC.

title: TLS — rasburicase + hydration + monitor electrolytes; allopurinol for moderate-risk
recommendation: Risk-stratify low/int/high. HIGH RISK (Burkitt/ALL/bulky/WBC>50): rasburicase 0.2 mg/kg IV daily × 1-7 d — G6PD test FIRST (haemolysis); avoid bicarb. INTERMEDIATE: allopurinol 300-600 mg/d (interactions: 6-MP/AZA reduce). Aggressive hydration 3 L/m²/24h NS, UO > 100 ml/m²/h. Cytoreductive pre-phase chemo for Burkitt. ESTABLISHED TLS: rasburicase + fluids + treat hyperK (Ca gluconate + insulin/dex + Resonium/patiromer + dialysis); hyperPO4 (binder; dialysis); HYPOCa replace ONLY if symptomatic (avoid worsening Ca-PO4 product); AKI dialysis. Cardiac monitor. Continue underlying treatment + supportive. AVOID K+ fluids + Ca/PO4 supplements + thiazide. CLL venetoclax: VERY SLOW ramp-up + admit first dose. CAR-T cell: TLS first 1-2 wk. Refer nephrology.
rationale: Cairo-Bishop + BSH 2015/2024 + ESMO 2024 + Coiffier JCO 2008.

title: MSCC — MRI within 24h + dexamethasone 16 mg + surgery vs RT within 24h
indicators: back pain in cancer / new neurological signs
recommendation: ANY cancer patient with back pain = MRI whole spine within 24h (regardless of neuro signs). Bed rest + log-roll until stability assessed. DEXAMETHASONE 16 mg IV stat then 4-8 mg q6h immediately. Analgesia + VTE prophylaxis + catheter if retention. Spinal MDT within 24h: SURGERY if single-site + good performance status + life expectancy > 3 mo + radio-resistant tumour + instability / tissue Dx needed (Patchell — surgery + RT > RT alone within 14 d paralysis); RT for radiosensitive (lymphoma/myeloma/breast/prostate/lung) / multiple levels / poor surgical candidate. SBRT for oligometastatic. Bisphosphonate / denosumab for bone disease. Chemo for chemosensitive. Rehab + bladder/bowel + pain + psychological. Pre-treatment ambulatory: 75-90% retain ambulation. Time = key. Median survival 3-6 mo.
rationale: NICE NG196 + Patchell Lancet 2005 + ASCO/ASTRO 2024.

title: HCM — IV saline + zoledronic acid 4 mg; denosumab if renal failure
recommendation: Correct Ca for albumin (Ca + 0.02 × (40 − alb)). IV saline 3-6 L/24h (cautious cardiac/renal). ZOLEDRONIC ACID 4 mg IV over 15-30 min — drug of choice (onset 24-48h, peak 4-7 d, duration 4 wk); renal dose adjust if eGFR < 30. DENOSUMAB 120 mg SC for refractory/renal failure (no renal adjust). Steroid (hydrocortisone 100 mg q6h then pred 40-60 mg) for vitamin-D-mediated (lymphoma/granulomatous). Calcitonin 4-8 IU/kg q6-12h bridge (rapid, short, tachyphylaxis). Dialysis for refractory + AKI. AVOID thiazide/lithium/Ca-D supplements/loop diuretic first-line (only after repletion); encourage MOBILISATION (immobility worsens). Address underlying malignancy. Bisphosphonate/denosumab prophylaxis for bone mets. Monitor: daily Ca/PO4/Cr/U&E/ECG. ONJ risk — dental review pre-treatment.
rationale: ASCO 2023 + ESMO 2020/2024 + ASBMR.

title: SVCO — tissue diagnosis FIRST + dexamethasone + endovascular stent / chemo
indicators: facial / arm swelling + dilated chest veins + dyspnoea
recommendation: Head + upper body elevation; O2 if hypoxic; lower-limb IV access; furosemide for facial oedema. TISSUE DIAGNOSIS BEFORE definitive treatment (UNLESS airway emergency) — biopsy lymph node / CT-guided mass / bronchoscopy / mediastinoscopy. DEXAMETHASONE 4-16 mg BD-QDS (controversial if biopsy not done — may interfere with lymphoma Dx). DEFINITIVE: SCLC chemo+RT; LYMPHOMA chemo + steroid (R-CHOP) — chemosensitive; germ cell cisplatin chemo — curable; ENDOVASCULAR STENT for rapid symptom relief / refractory / palliation — anticoagulate after; thrombolysis for clot-predominant (line-related) + remove line. Manage stridor — anaesthesia/ENT; sitting intubation if needed.
rationale: ESMO 2024 + NCCN + RCR + Cochrane.

title: irAE — hold ICI + steroid + escalate immunosuppression by grade
recommendation: CTCAE grading. G1 mild: continue ICI + monitor. G2 moderate: hold ICI + prednisolone 0.5-1 mg/kg + resume when ≤G1. G3 severe: hold + pred 1-2 mg/kg (or IV methylpred) + admit; taper 4-6 wk; permanently discontinue most G3 + ALL G4. G4 life-threatening: IV methylpred 1-2 mg/kg + permanent discontinue + ESCALATE if not improving 48-72h: colitis (infliximab/vedolizumab), hepatitis (MMF/AZA), pneumonitis (IVIG/MMF/CYC/tocilizumab + PCP prophylaxis), MYOCARDITIS (high-dose methylpred 1 g + IVIG/MMF/abatacept/ATG — high mortality), neuro (IVIG + PLEX + steroid). ENDOCRINE: hypophysitis = hydrocortisone STAT + replacement; T1DM = insulin; thyroiditis = β-blocker hyper-phase then levothyroxine — usually CONTINUE ICI for endocrine. PCP prophylaxis for prolonged ≥ 20 mg pred ≥ 4 wk. irAE card + report immediately. AVOID live vaccines.
rationale: ASCO 2024 + ESMO 2024 + NCCN + SITC.

title: CINV — emetogenic risk-stratified prophylaxis with olanzapine quadruplet for HEC
recommendation: Risk-stratify chemo regimen emetogenic potential. HIGH (cisplatin/AC): 5-HT3 + NK1 (aprepitant/fosaprepitant) + dex 12 mg + OLANZAPINE 5-10 mg D1 + days 2-4 dex/aprepitant/olanzapine continuation — olanzapine-containing regimen superior (Navari NEJM 2016). MODERATE: 5-HT3 + dex + add NK1 for carboplatin AUC ≥ 4. LOW: 5-HT3 or dex or metoclopramide D1. MINIMAL: no prophylactic. Breakthrough: add different class — olanzapine / metoclopramide / prochlorperazine / lorazepam (anxiety). Refractory: combo + mirtazapine / cannabinoid + pre-medicate anticipatory with lorazepam. Manage 5-HT3 constipation + QTc. Adjuncts: ginger / P6 acupressure / mindfulness. Hydration + electrolytes. Pregnancy in cancer: ondansetron + metoclopramide + steroid — avoid NK1.
rationale: ASCO 2024 + ESMO/MASCC + NCCN + Navari NEJM 2016.

title: Cancer pain — modified WHO ladder + opioid titration + adjuvants + side-effect management
recommendation: Assess: location/character/intensity/mechanism. Step 1 (NRS 1-3): paracetamol 1 g q6h + NSAID (with PPI; avoid CKD/GIB/HF). Step 2 (NRS 4-6): + weak opioid codeine/tramadol or skip to step 3 low-dose. Step 3 (NRS ≥ 7): STRONG OPIOID — morphine 5-10 mg q4h IR then convert to MR BD; breakthrough 1/6-1/10 daily PRN q1-4h; alternatives oxycodone (1.5-2× more potent PO) / hydromorphone (7×) / fentanyl patch (stable pain) / methadone (complex — specialist). Manage SIDE EFFECTS PROACTIVELY: constipation (routine laxative + methylnaltrexone), nausea (haloperidol/metoclopramide), sedation, respiratory depression (cautious naloxone in tolerant), confusion (rotation), itch, myoclonus (rotation). Rotation: reduce calculated dose 25-50% (incomplete cross-tolerance). ADJUVANTS: gabapentin/pregabalin/amitriptyline/duloxetine for neuropathic; bisphosphonate/denosumab/RT for bone; steroid for liver capsule/raised ICP/cord compression; ketamine specialist. Address SSA OPIOID ACCESS GAP — WHO essential medicines + Kenya KEHPRO advocacy.
rationale: WHO 2018 + NICE CSG4 + ESMO 2024 + ASCO 2024 + Lancet Commission.

title: EoL — anticipatory prescribing + holistic comfort + family + bereavement
recommendation: Multidisciplinary recognition of dying. Stop unnecessary meds + investigations; focus on comfort. Anticipatory prescribing SC PRN: morphine 2.5-5 mg q1-4h (pain/breathlessness), midazolam 2.5-5 mg (distress/agitation), cyclizine 50 mg or haloperidol 0.5-1.5 mg (nausea), hyoscine butylbromide 20 mg (secretions). Switch to CSCI/syringe driver when oral compromised. Symptom-specific: breathlessness — non-pharm + low-dose opioid + benzo + O2 only if hypoxic; agitation/delirium — identify cause + midazolam + haloperidol; secretions — hyoscine + reposition + family preparation; nausea — mechanism-targeted. Limited artificial hydration/nutrition (often worsens secretions). Communication + cultural/religious sensitivity. Place of death preferences. After-death care, bereavement support, staff debrief. SSA palliative care gap — advocate hospice expansion + community model (Hospice Africa Uganda).
rationale: WHO Palliative Strategy 2014/2024 + Lancet Commission 2018 + EAPC + NICE NG31.

title: Cancer VTE — DOAC first-line (apixaban/edoxaban/rivaroxaban); LMWH if GI luminal
indicators: confirmed DVT / PE in cancer patient
recommendation: Anticoagulation: DOAC FIRST-LINE most (apixaban 10 BD × 7 d then 5 BD per CARAVAGGIO; rivaroxaban 15 BD × 21 then 20 OD per SELECT-D; edoxaban 60 OD per Hokusai). LMWH preferred for: luminal GI cancer (DOAC GI bleed), brain tumour/mets, drug interactions (CYP3A4), thrombocytopaenia 50-100 (dose-reduce), pregnancy, severe renal/hepatic. Warfarin obsolete in cancer VTE. Duration ≥ 6 mo; consider indefinite while cancer active + treatment. Massive PE: thrombolysis if no contraindication (balance bleeding). Breakthrough on AC: switch to/up LMWH + investigate adherence. Catheter thrombosis: anticoag + remove only if essential/sepsis. PRIMARY PROPHYLAXIS: pancreatic/lung/Khorana ≥ 2 outpatient — rivaroxaban 10 OD (CASSINI) or apixaban 2.5 BD (AVERT) × 6 mo; multiple myeloma on lenalidomide/pomalidomide; surgical cancer extended 28 d post-major abdo. Thrombocytopaenia: LMWH dose-reduce + platelet support. Pregnancy: LMWH (no DOAC/warfarin).
rationale: ITAC 2022/2024 + ASCO 2023 + ESMO 2023 + CARAVAGGIO + Hokusai-VTE Cancer + CASSINI + AVERT.

title: Paediatric severe pneumonia — IMCI + amoxicillin DT 40-50 mg/kg + O2
indicators: age-appropriate tachypnoea + chest indrawing / danger signs
recommendation: WHO IMCI/Kenya MOH classification. Non-severe (no indrawing/no danger): home amoxicillin DT 40 mg/kg BD × 3 d + counsel return + extra fluids + continue feeding. SEVERE (indrawing/danger signs): admit + O2 if sats < 90% (target > 90%) + amoxicillin DT 40-50 mg/kg BD × 5 d (WHO 2014); severe with danger signs IV ampicillin 50 mg/kg q6h + gentamicin 7.5 mg/kg OD × 5 d; failure / very severe ceftriaxone 80 mg/kg/d + cloxacillin if Staph. HIV+ + LRTI: cotrim 8 mg TMP/kg BD × 21 d + pred if hypoxia. Vitamin A 100-200k IU + zinc 10-20 mg × 10 d. CAUTIOUS IV fluids (FEAST harm in non-shock African children). Bubble CPAP for hypoxic infants (mortality benefit). Pulse oximetry MANDATORY (WHO 2014). Vaccinate (PCV13 + Hib + measles + RSV emerging). Address indoor air pollution. Discharge sats > 90% + feeding + counsel + follow-up 48-72h.
rationale: WHO IMCI 2014/2024 + Kenya Basic Paeds Protocols + FEAST + bubble CPAP trials.

title: Neonatal sepsis — ampicillin + gent EOS / vanc + cefepime LOS + LP all
indicators: sick neonate / risk factors / temp / feeding / behaviour change
recommendation: Assume sepsis until proven otherwise. ALWAYS LP (meningitis 25%). Blood + urine cultures + FBC + CRP + glucose + LFT + coag + HSV PCR if vesicles. EARLY-ONSET (< 72h): ampicillin 50-100 mg/kg q12h + gentamicin 4-5 mg/kg/d (preterm 3-4 q24-36h); add acyclovir 60 mg/kg/d if HSV suspected; 10 d if culture+, 14 d standard, 21 d meningitis. LATE-ONSET (> 72h): vancomycin + gent/amikacin; cefepime/pip-tazo/meropenem if NICU-acquired; antifungal (fluconazole 12 mg/kg) prolonged NICU/line/TPN; acyclovir if HSV. Supportive: thermoneutral (KMC); glucose 2.6-5; O2; CAUTIOUS fluid (FEAST); adrenaline pressor; phenobarbital seizure; vitamin K 1 mg IM; breastmilk priority. Treat specifics: GBS pen G 250k IU/kg/d; Listeria amp+gent 14-21 d; HSV acyclovir 14-21+; Candida fluconazole/amphoB. PREVENTION: IAP GBS (pen G 5 MU + 2.5 MU q4h); skilled birth + clean delivery + chlorhexidine cord (WHO); PMTCT HIV; maternal screening syphilis/UTI/BV; Tdap.
rationale: WHO Pocket Book 2024 + Kenya Basic Paeds + AAP 2018 + NICE NG195.

title: Paeds DKA — slow rehydration 48h + insulin 0.05-0.1 U/kg/h + cerebral oedema watch
recommendation: ISPAD 2022. ASSESS shock vs not. Shock only: 10-20 ml/kg crystalloid bolus over 30-60 min (NOT routinely); maintenance + replace deficit (max 5-10%) over 48h slowly (NOT 24h). 0.9% NaCl → 0.45% NaCl + D5% when glucose < 14-17. Start insulin AFTER 1h fluid; 0.05-0.1 U/kg/h IV (NO bolus); continue basal insulin if on (reduces rebound). Target glucose drop 3-5 mmol/L/h (no faster). K+ replacement early (40 mmol/L if 3.5-5.5; HOLD INSULIN if K+ < 3.5); NO routine bicarb (worsens cerebral oedema risk); PO4 only if < 0.3. CEREBRAL OEDEMA (1% mortality cause): immediate mannitol 0.5-1 g/kg OR 3% NaCl 5 ml/kg over 10-15 min + reduce fluid rate 1/3 + head-up + URGENT CT after stabilising + PICU; AVOID rapid drop in Na (corrected Na should rise as glucose falls). Switch to SC insulin when ketones < 0.5 + pH > 7.3 + HCO3 > 18 + eating (overlap 1h). Treat trigger (infection, missed insulin, diabulimia). Post-DKA: diabetes education + DAFNE + CGM + psychology + celiac/thyroid screen.
rationale: ISPAD 2022 + PECARN NEJM 2018 + BSPED 2024.

title: SAM — F-75 stabilisation + AVOID IV bolus + amoxicillin + vitamin A + slow transition
recommendation: WHO 10 steps: 1) hypoglycaemia (give 10% glucose 50 ml + F-75 q2-3h), 2) hypothermia (skin-to-skin), 3) dehydration AVOID IV resus unless shock (FEAST harm) — use ReSoMal 5 ml/kg q30 min PO/NG, 4) K replenish 3-4 mmol/kg/d + Mg, 5) prophylactic AMOXICILLIN 50 mg/kg/d × 5-7 d (uncomplicated); IV ampicillin + gentamicin (complicated); cotrim if HIV+; malaria if RDT+; 6) vitamin A day 1 (unless oedema/recent dose) 50-200k IU + folate 5 mg d1 then 1 mg + multivit + zinc; NO iron in phase 1, 7) F-75 130 ml/kg/d in 8-12 feeds (low protein/lactose-free), 8) refeeding syndrome watch (PO4/K/Mg), 9) transition to F-100/RUTF when appetite returns + oedema resolving, 10) RUTF 200 kcal/kg/d OTP weekly until WHZ ≥ -2 / MUAC ≥ 12.5 × 2 visits + no oedema × 2 wk. Stimulation + Care for Child Development. HIV/TB integrated care. Late mortality (> 6 mo) high — continued community follow-up critical.
rationale: WHO SAM 2023 + Kenya IMAM 2023 + FEAST.

title: Severe paeds malaria — IV artesunate (AQUAMAT) + glucose + complete ACT
indicators: fever + parasitaemia + danger signs (coma/severe anaemia/respiratory distress/hypoglycaemia)
recommendation: ABCDE. ALWAYS check glucose (give D10% 5 ml/kg if < 2.2). IV ARTESUNATE 2.4 mg/kg at 0/12/24h then daily (3 mg/kg if < 20 kg) per AQUAMAT (superior to quinine). Switch to oral artemether-lumefantrine 6 doses × 3 days when tolerating + ≥ 24h IV. AVOID phenytoin prophylactic; benzodiazepines for seizure. Severe anaemia: transfuse if Hb < 5 + symptomatic OR < 4 routine (10 ml/kg over 3-4h + furosemide). Empirical ceftriaxone 80 mg/kg/d for severe (Salmonella co-infection SSA). CAUTIOUS fluid (FEAST — bolus harm in non-shock African children); maintenance 5% dextrose with monitored UO. Watch DELAYED HAEMOLYSIS post-artesunate (1-3 wk — check FBC follow-up). PREVENTION: ITN + IPTp-SP maternal + seasonal malaria chemoprophylaxis Sahel + R21/RTS,S vaccine (Kenya pilot in Western — substantial mortality reduction).
rationale: WHO Malaria 2023/2024 + AQUAMAT Lancet 2010 + Kenya National Malaria Treatment + R21/RTS,S.

title: Paeds trauma — cABCDE with age-norms + cautious fluid + TXA within 3h + NAI screen
recommendation: Age-appropriate vital sign norms (compensate well — hypotension LATE). cABCDE: tourniquet/pelvic binder; airway with c-spine (neutral with shoulder roll for large occiput); ETT size (age/4)+4 mm; RSI ketamine 1-2 + rocuronium 1.2 + atropine pre-treat < 1 yr. Treat tension PTX (anterior axillary preferred). IV × 2 large-bore peripheral or IO if failed 90s. Crystalloid 20 ml/kg balanced bolus over 5-10 min; reassess; permissive hypotension cautious in paeds; blood early; TXA 15 mg/kg (max 1 g) IV within 3h (CRASH-2/ENGAGE). MTP 1:1:1. Glucose 5 ml/kg D10% if < 2.2. Prevent hypothermia (high risk). Head injury SBP > 110 + sats > 94 + head-up 30 + hypertonic saline 3% 3 ml/kg (preferred over mannitol paeds) + CT per PECARN. C-spine: NEXUS/Canadian paeds rule; AVOID routine CT < 8 yr; SCIWORA. Pelvic binder at greater trochanters. SCREEN FOR NON-ACCIDENTAL INJURY (multiple injuries different ages, inconsistent history, specific patterns, retinal haemorrhages, posterior rib/metaphyseal corner fractures) — mandatory reporting per Children Act + Sexual Offences Act.
rationale: ATLS 10e + APLS 7e + PALS 2024 + RCEM + PECARN + CRASH-2.

title: Child abuse — recognise patterns + mandatory report + 72h HIV PEP if SA
indicators: suspected abuse / disclosure / suspicious injuries / SA
recommendation: RECOGNISE: inconsistent history, delayed presentation, multiple injuries different ages, patterns (cigarette burns, immersion lines, posterior rib/metaphyseal corner fractures, shaken baby — retinal haemorrhages + subdural), genital trauma, behavioural change. Document carefully (body map, photographs per protocol, measurements). Trained interviewer for SA (avoid leading questions). Skeletal survey for young + repeat at 10-14 d; fundoscopy; CT head if neuro. SEXUAL ASSAULT < 72h: HIV PEP TLD × 28 d (NASCOP) + EC if < 120h + STI prophylaxis (ceftriaxone + azithromycin + metronidazole) + Hep B vaccine ± HBIG + tetanus. MANDATORY REPORTING per Kenya Children Act 2022 + Sexual Offences Act 2006 — Children's Officer + Police Gender Desk + DCI + child protection team + PRC1/P3 forms. Safety plan + place of safety + restraining order if needed. MULTIDISCIPLINARY: SGBV one-stop centre + Childline Kenya 116 + counsellor + legal aid (FIDA, Kituo cha Sheria) + NGOs. FGM (Anti-FGM Act 2011) + child marriage (Marriage Act 2014). Long-term TF-CBT + family therapy with safety priority. INSPIRE 7 strategies prevention.
rationale: Kenya Children Act 2022 + Sexual Offences Act + Anti-FGM Act + WHO INSPIRE + WHO Clinical Handbook + RCPCH.

title: KMC — immediate skin-to-skin (WHO 2022 paradigm shift) — all preterm/LBW
recommendation: WHO 2022 RECOMMENDATION — INITIATE KMC IMMEDIATELY AFTER BIRTH (no stabilisation needed first — iKMC NEJM 2021 reduced mortality 25%). Continuous skin-to-skin 24h/day with mother (or surrogate). Position: infant naked + nappy + cap, upright between breasts, head turned to side, hips frog-flexed; cover with mother's clothing + warm cloth. EXCLUSIVE BREASTFEEDING (cup feeding for non-suckling preterm — avoid bottles); donor milk if needed. Monitor temp/HR/RR/glucose. Daily weight target 15-20 g/kg/d. Vitamin K 1 mg IM at birth + eye prophylaxis + Hep B birth dose + BCG/OPV0 + chlorhexidine cord (WHO low-resource). Reduces mortality 25-40% + infection + improves breastfeeding + bonding + cardiac/respiratory stability + cost-effective LMIC. Discharge ~1800-2000g + weight gain + feeding well + mother trained + community follow-up. Father involvement ('kangaroo dad'). Kenya MOH KMC scaling + Lancet Every Newborn Action Plan.
rationale: WHO 2022 + iKMC NEJM 2021 + Lancet Every Newborn + Kenya MOH KMC.

title: Neonatal jaundice — phototherapy per nomogram + investigate prolonged + < 24h pathological
indicators: clinical jaundice / TcB raised / SBR for treatment threshold
recommendation: AAP 2022 nomogram by age/gestation/risk factors. < 24h = pathological — investigate (ABO/Rh DAT, G6PD, sepsis, congenital infection). PHOTOTHERAPY: maximise efficiency (nappy + eye protection + max skin exposure + double-bank for high levels + intensive triple-bank); continue breastfeeding; monitor SBR q6-12h; stop when > 50 below threshold + falling; check REBOUND 12-24h after stopping. IVIG 0.5-1 g/kg for isoimmune haemolytic disease reaching exchange threshold. EXCHANGE TRANSFUSION (double-volume 160-200 ml/kg) if approaching neurotoxic + failed intensive phototherapy — ICU/HDU. Treat cause: sepsis (antibiotics), hypothyroid (levothyroxine), G6PD (avoid triggers + supportive), BILIARY ATRESIA (urgent Kasai BEFORE 8 weeks — best outcomes). Prolonged > 14 d term/21 d preterm: workup conjugated + LFT + TFT + G6PD + biliary atresia screen. CRITICAL kernicterus prevention in SSA — train CHV + reduce late presentation + solar phototherapy innovation.
rationale: AAP 2022 + NICE CG98 + WHO Pocket Book + Kenya Basic Paeds.

title: Paeds asthma — GINA age-specific + spacer always + dexa or pred for acute
recommendation: GINA 2024 age-specific. ≤ 5 yr: SABA prn → daily low-dose ICS via spacer + face mask → double ICS or add LTRA. ≥ 6 yr: as-needed ICS-formoterol (preferred) → daily ICS-LABA → medium/high-dose + biologic referral (omalizumab/mepolizumab/dupilumab). NEVER SABA-only. SPACER ALWAYS for < 8 yr (mask < 4, mouthpiece 4-7). ACUTE: salbutamol 4-10 puffs spacer q20 min × 1h + DEXAMETHASONE 0.3-0.6 mg/kg × 1-2 doses (equivalent to pred + better compliance) or prednisolone 1-2 mg/kg × 3-5 d; severe — neb salbutamol+ipratropium + IV MgSO4 40 mg/kg + IV steroid; refractory IV salbutamol infusion (caution arrhythmia/hypoK); INTUBATE only if absolutely needed (dynamic hyperinflation + PTX risk). O2 target sats > 94%. Watch hypoK + hypoglycaemia. Triggers: viral (#1 children), allergens (dust mite/pollen/dander), exercise, cold air, SMOKING EXPOSURE (counsel cessation + smoke-free home — major SSA), INDOOR AIR POLLUTION (improved cookstoves). Allergic comorbidity 'one airway' — treat AR + eczema. EPI vaccines + annual flu + pneumococcal + COVID. Refer specialist refractory / Step 4+ / atypical / biologic candidate.
rationale: GINA 2024 paeds + BTS/SIGN + ERS/ATS Severe + NICE NG80 + PRACTALL.

title: RA — early treat-to-target with MTX + add bDMARD/JAK if not at target at 3-6 mo
indicators: symmetric polyarthritis + anti-CCP / RF / ACR EULAR 2010 criteria
recommendation: Treat-to-target DAS28 < 2.6. Start MTX 7.5-25 mg/wk + folate + bridge low-dose pred 5-15 mg taper. If not at target by 3-6 mo: add another csDMARD (triple = MTX+SSZ+HCQ) OR add bDMARD/tsDMARD. bDMARDs: anti-TNF (etan/ada/infl/golim/cert), anti-IL-6 (tocilizumab/sarilumab), rituximab, abatacept. JAK inhibitors (tofa/bari/upa) — BOXED WARNINGS (VTE/MACE/cancer especially > 65 + CV/smoker) — reserve. Combine bDMARD with MTX. SCREEN before bDMARD: hepatitis B/C, HIV, TB (IGRA + CXR), pregnancy. Pneumococcal + flu + COVID BEFORE bDMARD. NO LIVE on bDMARD/JAK/MTX. Pregnancy: AVOID MTX (3 mo washout both partners) + leflunomide (cholestyramine washout); HCQ + SSZ safe; certolizumab preferred TNF. Monitor: DAS28 + FBC + LFT + Cr; HCQ retinal screen annual > 5 yr. Address CV risk (RA doubles); bone (steroid + RA).
rationale: EULAR 2024 + ACR 2024 + NICE NG100 + Treat-to-Target Task Force.

title: SLE — HCQ for ALL + MMF/CYC + steroid for lupus nephritis
recommendation: HCQ 200-400 mg/d for ALMOST ALL (reduces flares + mortality + organ damage; continue pregnancy). Sun protection + vitamin D + smoking cessation + vaccinations (no live on immunosuppression). MILD-MODERATE: HCQ + topical/short pred + AZA/MTX/MMF if persistent; belimumab or anifrolumab refractory. LUPUS NEPHRITIS PROLIFERATIVE (Class III/IV): IV pulse methylpred 500-1000 mg × 3 d then pred 0.5-1 mg/kg taper + MMF 2-3 g/d (or low-dose IV CYC 500 mg q2 wk × 6 — EuroLupus). Maintenance MMF 1-2 g (ALMS) or AZA, continue ≥ 2-3 yr; voclosporin add-on (AURORA); belimumab + MMF (BLISS-LN). MEMBRANOUS (V): MMF + steroid or CNI. NEUROPSYCHIATRIC SLE: differentiate inflammatory (steroid + CYC/RTX) vs thrombotic (anticoag for APS). ACUTE FLARE: identify trigger + escalate. PREGNANCY: quiescent ≥ 6 mo, continue HCQ, switch teratogens BEFORE, aspirin from 12 wk, fetal cardiac if anti-Ro/La. African ancestry — more severe + advocacy for access in SSA.
rationale: EULAR 2023/2024 + ACR 2024 + KDIGO 2024 + ALMS + BLISS-LN + AURORA.

title: Gout — colchicine/NSAID/steroid acute + allopurinol target SU < 360 + prophylaxis 3-6 mo
recommendation: Joint aspirate for crystals + rule out septic (gold standard especially first attack). ACUTE: NSAID + PPI / colchicine 1.2 mg STAT then 0.6 mg at 1h then 0.6 mg q12h / steroid (pred 30-40 mg × 5-10 d — first-line if CKD/GI/CV) / IA steroid. ULT initiate if tophi / ≥ 2 attacks/y / CKD / urolithiasis / very high urate — CAN START DURING acute attack + ANTI-INFLAMMATORY PROPHYLAXIS 3-6 mo (colchicine 0.6 mg / low-dose NSAID / pred). ALLOPURINOL 50-100 mg start titrate to TARGET SERUM URATE < 360 µmol/L (< 300 if tophi); HLA-B*5801 test before in Han Chinese/Korean/Thai/African ancestry. Renal dose adjust. Drug interactions (AZA/6-MP/warfarin). Febuxostat alternative — CARES CV signal. Uricosurics for non-renal/non-stone. Pegloticase refractory tophi. LIFESTYLE: weight loss 10%, reduce ETOH (beer/spirits), red meat/organ/seafood/fructose, low-fat dairy, hydrate. SWITCH diuretic if possible (worsens). SGLT2i in DM lowers urate.

title: axSpA — NSAIDs + exercise; biologic if BASDAI ≥ 4 + spine pain ≥ 4
recommendation: Exercise + physiotherapy + smoking cessation FOUNDATION. NSAID first-line continuous (naproxen/indo/etoricoxib) — may slow progression; topical/IA steroid for peripheral arthritis; AVOID systemic steroid (limited efficacy axial). csDMARD (SSZ/MTX) for PERIPHERAL only (ineffective axial). BIOLOGIC if ≥ 2 NSAID failure + BASDAI ≥ 4 + spinal pain ≥ 4: anti-TNF (etan/ada/infl/golim/cert), IL-17i (secu/ixe/bime), JAK (upa — BBW). Comorbidity: uveitis — anti-TNF mAb preferred (NOT etanercept for uveitis); IBD — anti-TNF mAb (NOT etanercept; NOT IL-17 — may worsen); psoriasis — IL-17/TNFi/IL-23. AVOID IL-23 for axial SpA (ineffective). OSTEOPOROSIS common: DEXA + bisphosphonate; vit D + Ca. SURGICAL: hip/shoulder replacement; spinal osteotomy for kyphosis (selected). ANKYLOSED spine + minor trauma = fracture (high mortality cervical) — cautious handling + alert anaesthesia. Pregnancy: often improves; NSAIDs 1st-2nd trim (NOT 3rd — ductus); certolizumab preferred TNF. Vaccinations pre-biologic; no live.
rationale: ASAS-EULAR 2024 + ACR/SAA 2024 + BRITSpA + BSR.

title: ANCA vasculitis — CYC/RTX + steroid induction; RTX maintenance; avacopan
recommendation: Tissue + ANCA pattern. SEVERE/ORGAN-THREATENING induction: cyclophosphamide 15 mg/kg IV pulses or 2 mg/kg PO × 3-6 mo + high-dose pulse methylpred 500-1000 × 3 d then pred 1 mg/kg taper; OR rituximab 375 mg/m² × 4 (RAVE/RITUXVAS non-inferior; preferred PR3+/relapsing/fertility preservation). PLEX for pulmonary haemorrhage / severe AKI requiring dialysis (PEXIVAS modest). AVACOPAN (C5a antagonist; ADVOCATE) — steroid-sparing newer. MAINTENANCE ≥ 2-3 yr: rituximab 500 mg q6 mo × 2 yr (MAINRITSAN superior) or AZA 1.5-2 mg/kg or MMF or MTX. EGPA: mepolizumab for non-severe corticosteroid-dependent (MIRRA). Severe relapse: re-induce RTX preferred. PROPHYLAXIS: cotrim PCP (high-dose immunosuppression); vaccinations BEFORE biologic (no live); bone health + vit D + bisphosphonate. FERTILITY: CYC reduces — banking pre-treatment; rituximab preferred young. Pregnancy: plan in remission + switch teratogens. Monitor BVAS/VDI + ANCA + Cr + UA. CV risk + bladder/skin cancer surveillance.
rationale: EULAR-ERA-EDTA 2024 + ACR/VF 2024 + RAVE + PEXIVAS + ADVOCATE + MAINRITSAN.

title: PMR pred 15-20 mg / GCA pred 40-60 mg or pulse if visual; tocilizumab steroid-sparing
indicators: age ≥ 50 + bilateral shoulder/hip pain (PMR) or temporal headache/jaw claud/visual (GCA)
recommendation: PMR: clinical + ESR/CRP raised + rapid response to pred 15-20 mg/d (dramatic within 1 wk supportive); taper 2.5 mg q2-4 wk to 10 mg then 1 mg q4-8 wk; 12-24 mo total. GCA: VISUAL SYMPTOMS or large-vessel — IV methylpred 500-1000 × 3 d then pred 1 mg/kg; NO visual symptoms — pred 40-60 mg/d; START IMMEDIATELY (do NOT wait for biopsy — vision loss permanent + bilateral). Temporal artery biopsy within 1 wk (positive up to 2 wk after starting steroid). TOCILIZUMAB (GiACTA — first-line steroid-sparing GCA) or MTX. Aspirin 75 mg in GCA. Slow taper; 2-3 yr total GCA. Bone protection: DEXA + bisphosphonate within 3 mo > 7.5 mg pred × 3 mo + vit D + Ca. PPI GI protection. PCP cotrim if > 20 mg × 4 wk. Monitor steroid SE (BP/glucose/weight/mood/eye/infection/bone). Aortic surveillance annually GCA (aneurysm). Steroid card + sick day rules + MedicAlert.
rationale: BSR PMR + EULAR/ACR + EULAR LVV 2024 + GiACTA + SEMAPHORE.

title: APS — warfarin INR 2-3 (AVOID DOAC triple-positive/arterial) + aspirin obstetric
indicators: thrombosis or pregnancy morbidity + persistent positive LA/aCL/anti-β2GP1
recommendation: Sydney criteria (LA/aCL/anti-β2GP1 — persistent 12 wk apart). VTE/arterial thrombosis: WARFARIN target INR 2-3 (target 3-4 for arterial/recurrent VTE on standard INR); AVOID DOACs in triple-positive (TRAPS), arterial, recurrent — DOAC only in selected single-positive low-risk VTE after discussion. Indefinite anticoag. Add HCQ for SLE-APS + aspirin 75 mg + statin (CV). OBSTETRIC APS: aspirin 75-150 mg from positive pregnancy + prophylactic LMWH throughout pregnancy + 6 wk postpartum (treatment dose if VTE/arterial history); HCQ; multi-D obstetric. CATASTROPHIC APS: ICU + heparin + steroid + PLEX or IVIG + rituximab/eculizumab refractory. ASYMPTOMATIC + APL: low-dose aspirin 75-100 mg controversial — consider high-risk (triple-positive); aggressive CV risk modification + HCQ if SLE. Avoid combined OCP (DVT); use progestin/IUD. Periop bridge LMWH. Patient education + alert card.
rationale: EULAR 2024 + ACR/VF + BSH + TRAPS + RAPS.

title: Fibromyalgia — education + exercise + CBT + duloxetine/pregabalin/amitriptyline; AVOID opioids
indicators: widespread pain ≥ 3 mo + fatigue + sleep + cognitive
recommendation: Clinical 2010/2016 ACR criteria (WPI + SS). Rule out alternative: TSH/CK/ESR-CRP/FBC/vitD. Education + validate (nociplastic pain — central sensitisation); functional goals (not pain-free). NON-PHARM strongest evidence: GRADED AEROBIC EXERCISE + CBT/ACT + MBSR + sleep hygiene + CBT-I + multi-D pain rehab + aquatic. PHARM modest: AMITRIPTYLINE 10-50 mg nocte (sleep+pain+mood), DULOXETINE 30-120 mg or milnacipran 50-100 BD (FDA-approved), PREGABALIN 75-450 mg/d. AVOID strong opioids (hyperalgesia + addiction); tramadol short-term cautious (5-HT syndrome with SNRI/SSRI). AVOID benzo. NSAIDs ineffective fibro primary (use for comorbid OA). Sleep: exclude OSA + RLS. Treat psychiatric comorbidity (depression/anxiety/PTSD). Diet anti-inflammatory + weight + avoid caffeine excess. Workplace accommodations + vocational rehab. Trauma-informed care. Continuity of care critical — avoid 'shopping'. Re-evaluate diagnosis if focal neuro / joint swelling / constitutional / very high inflammatory markers.
rationale: EULAR 2017 + APS/ACR 2018 + AAPT 2019 + Cochrane.

title: PID — 10 warning signs + Ig + functional + refer immunology; IVIG/SCIG replacement
indicators: recurrent / severe / unusual / pattern of infections / family history / Jeffrey Modell warning signs
recommendation: 10 Jeffrey Modell warning signs. Workup: FBC + lymphocyte count/smear, IgG/IgA/IgM/IgE, specific antibody response (tetanus/pneumococcal), lymphocyte subsets (CD3/4/8/19/56), complement (CH50/AH50/C3/C4); HIV ALWAYS (rule out); genetic NGS panel. Newborn SCID screening (TREC). REFER CLINICAL IMMUNOLOGY. ANTIBODY DEFICIENCY (CVID/XLA): IVIG 0.4-0.8 g/kg q3-4 wk OR SCIG 0.1-0.2 g/kg weekly (home self-admin); target trough IgG > 5 g/L (or higher); lifelong; antibiotic prophylaxis for chronic respiratory disease; vaccinations: AVOID LIVE on Ig replacement (or 3 mo after dose). T-CELL DEFICIENCY (SCID): HSCT BEFORE 3 mo age curative; gene therapy for ADA-SCID; avoid live vaccines + transfusions (irradiated CMV-neg leucodepleted); PCP cotrim. PHAGOCYTIC (CGD): antibiotic + antifungal prophylaxis + IFN-γ; HSCT considered. COMPLEMENT: meningococcal + Hib + pneumococcal vaccines essential; eculizumab for aHUS/PNH. Aggressive infection treatment + culture-directed + longer duration. Genetic counselling + family. SSA: HIV first; advocate IVIG access via NHIF; newborn screening expansion.
rationale: ESID 2024 + Jeffrey Modell + IUIS + NICE NG157.

title: SSc — organ-specific; ACEi for renal crisis; MMF/nintedanib/tocilizumab for ILD
recommendation: ACR/EULAR 2013 criteria. Antibody-organ associations: anti-centromere → limited + PAH; anti-Scl-70 → diffuse + ILD; anti-RNAP3 → renal crisis. NO disease-modifying cure — organ-specific. RAYNAUD'S/digital ulcers: warm + CCB (nifedipine/amlodipine) → PDE5i (sildenafil) for refractory → bosentan for new ulcers (RAPIDS-2) → IV iloprost severe. ILD: mycophenolate 2-3 g (Scleroderma Lung Study II — better safety than CYC) → CYC severe; NINTEDANIB antifibrotic (SENSCIS); TOCILIZUMAB early inflammatory (focuSSed); lung transplant. PAH: dual oral ERA + PDE5i (AMBITION) + prostacyclin high-risk + sotatercept (STELLAR). RENAL CRISIS EMERGENCY: ACEi captopril titrated FAST (start 6.25 mg, q4-8h); BP < 140/90 target; continue ACEi even if Cr worsens; dialysis if needed; AVOID steroid > 15 mg (precipitates renal crisis). GI: PPI for GERD; prokinetic for gastroparesis; rifaximin for SIBO; dietitian + PEG if severe. AUTOLOGOUS HSCT (ASTIS/SCOT) — severe early diffuse SSc + organ; cardiac screen essential. Pregnancy: plan when stable; AVOID ACEi for routine BP (need available for renal crisis). Monitor annually: PFT + DLCO + echo TR velocity + skin score + BP + UA + Cr. African ancestry — more severe.
rationale: EULAR 2017/2024 + ACR/BSR + SENSCIS + focuSSced + SLS II + ASTIS/SCOT.

title: HIV — TREAT-ALL + TLD (TDF/3TC/DTG) + same-day start + simplified monitoring
recommendation: TREAT-ALL regardless of CD4. RAPID/same-day start (within 7 days, ideally same day — RAPID/CASCADE trials). FIRST-LINE: TLD (TDF 300 + 3TC 300 + DTG 50 mg once daily). DTG safe in pregnancy + WCBP (Tsepamo + WAVES resolved NTD concern). TB co-treatment: DTG 50 mg BD with rifampicin; ART within 8 weeks (within 2 weeks if CD4 < 50 — SAPiT/CAMELIA/STRIDE). OI prophylaxis: cotrim if CD4 < 200 (PCP/toxo/falciparum); CrAg screen if CD4 < 100 → fluconazole + LP if positive; TB preventive therapy (3HP or 6H) for all HIV+ without active TB. Cervical Pap annually. Vaccinate hep B + pneumococcal + flu + COVID + HPV. SECOND-LINE on failure: DTG + change NRTI backbone (TAF+FTC or AZT+3TC) or PI (boosted darunavir). THIRD-LINE: lenacapavir SC q6mo + cabotegravir/rilpivirine IM monthly. Monitor VL at 6 months then annual; if > 1000 → enhanced adherence × 3 months + repeat. U=U communication. Differentiated service delivery (3-6 month dispensing). Adolescent: Operation Triple Zero. Kenya 95-95-95 by 2030.
rationale: WHO 2024 + Kenya NASCOP 2022 + IAS-USA 2024 + DHHS 2024 + Tsepamo + Sunlenca.

title: PrEP — oral TDF/FTC daily / cabotegravir LA q2mo / lenacapavir q6mo
recommendation: Confirm HIV-negative (4th-gen Ag/Ab + RNA if recent exposure suspected — acute HIV at PrEP initiation risks resistance). Hepatitis B status (TDF treats HBV — sudden withdrawal flare risk). Renal function (TDF). STI + pregnancy screen. ORAL: TDF/FTC (Truvada) once daily — > 95% efficacy with adherence; 2-1-1 on-demand for MSM only (not women — vaginal PK lag). INJECTABLE LA — game-changers: CABOTEGRAVIR-LA q2 monthly IM (HPTN 083/084 — superior to oral in AGYW + MSM); LENACAPAVIR SC q6 monthly (PURPOSE-1/2 2024 — 98-100% efficacy — most effective ever demonstrated, advocate access in SSA). Dapivirine ring monthly (HOPE/DREAM — moderate; option for women). FOLLOW-UP: 1 month + every 3 months (HIV test, STI, renal, adherence; LA — test before each injection). Acute HIV high suspicion: STOP PrEP + RNA + resistance + initiate ART. STOP PrEP: continue 28 d after last potential exposure. PEP within 72h high-risk exposure — TLD × 28 d. AGYW (Kenya DREAMS) integrated SRH + empowerment + safe schools. MSM/TGW/SW peer-led stigma-free clinics. SSPs + OAT for PWID.
rationale: WHO 2024 + Kenya NASCOP PrEP Framework + HPTN 083/084 + PURPOSE-1/2 + DREAMS.

title: TB DS — HRZE 2 mo / HR 4 mo OR new 4-month rifapentine+MFX; DTG with rifampicin BD
indicators: cough > 2 wk + sputum AFB/Xpert MTB/RIF positive
recommendation: Xpert MTB/RIF Ultra first-line (rapid + RIF resistance). Test ALL for HIV (Kenya algorithm). STANDARD: HRZE 2 mo intensive then HR 4 mo continuation (FDCs). NEW 4-MONTH (WHO 2022 — Study 31): rifapentine + INH + PZA + moxifloxacin × 17 wk for drug-sensitive pulmonary TB ≥ 12 yr ≥ 40 kg. TB MENINGITIS: 12 months + dexamethasone tapering (Thwaites — survival). TB-HIV: ART within 8 wk (within 2 wk if CD4 < 50 — SAPiT); DTG with rifampicin DOSE-DOUBLED to 50 mg BD; cotrim PCP prophylaxis; IRIS supportive — do NOT stop ART. Monitor LFTs monthly (INH+PZA hepatotoxic — hold if AST > 5× ULN); ethambutol visual acuity; pyridoxine 10-25 mg/d with INH (neuropathy prevention). DOT / video DOT / 99DOTS adherence. Sputum smear at 2, 5, 6 months. TPT for HIV+ + close contacts (3HP rifapentine+INH weekly × 12 OR 6H INH × 6 mo). Notify Kenya TIBU + contact tracing. Pregnancy: continue HRZE (avoid streptomycin — ototoxic); vitamin K mother last weeks; breastfeeding compatible.
rationale: WHO 2022 + Kenya TB Programme + TBTC Study 31 + Thwaites + SAPiT/STRIDE.

title: MDR/RR-TB — 6-mo BPaL/BPaLM all-oral (paradigm shift)
indicators: RIF resistance on Xpert / culture / treatment failure
recommendation: Comprehensive DST (LPA + culture). 6-MONTH ALL-ORAL BPaL (bedaquiline + pretomanid + linezolid) ± moxifloxacin (BPaLM) — WHO 2022 paradigm shift, TB-PRACTECAL/ZeNix/NIX-TB. Eligible: pulmonary RR/MDR ≥ 14 yr, regardless of HIV. Linezolid 600 mg × 26 wk; can extend to 9 mo if needed. CONTRAINDICATIONS: CNS/pericardial TB → longer regimen; pregnancy → avoid pretomanid → use bedaquiline + linezolid + clofazimine + cycloserine longer regimen. EXTENDED REGIMEN (9-20 mo): Group A (ALL — fluoroquinolone + bedaquiline + linezolid) + Group B (clofazimine + cycloserine) + Group C as needed. MONITORING: monthly ECG (QTc — bedaquiline + MFX + clofazimine all prolong QT — careful combined); FBC for linezolid myelosuppression; visual acuity + colour vision (linezolid optic neuritis); peripheral neuropathy (pyridoxine 200-300 mg with cycloserine); mental health (cycloserine — depression/suicide); LFT; thyroid; audiogram if injectable. Children: dispersible bedaquiline/delamanid; specialist input. HIV: concurrent DTG ART; cotrim. Kenya NTLP MDR-TB unit. Notify + intensive contact tracing + infection control + DSD when stable.
